intro.text: A Shin trader in Shinovar and a long-trusted friend of the Thaylen merchant Vstim.

items.text: Thresh regularly traded with foreigners, under a farmer's oversight, and could speak Thaylen. He swapped chickens, cloth and dried meats for Vstim's Soulcast scrap metal. Rysn noticed he haggled by playing down his own wares, which Vstim said was typical of Shin traders.
About seven years earlier, Thresh had given a Truthless man to Vstim. Vstim insisted on paying, but Thresh had to throw the money away, since the Shin may not take money for Truthless.

appearance.text: As a trader he may wear a colourful cape over his shirt and trousers, unlike Shin warriors and workers in plain brown.
